steps.text: Rubble bag: 1 Royal Favor tile of each character per player; all Clergy tiles in the Clergy Tile bag
Player board, Player Aid, 5 Rubble Set markers, 8 houses, 8 Officials
1 Good tile of each type and {n} reis
Draw 2 Clergy tiles, keep 1; draw 1 random Royal Favor tile; take 1 random Starting Plan
On the board: Courtier in the Royal Court, Wigs marker on 5, 1 Official in the Marquis's office
2 players: 1 Official of an unused color in each of the three Nobles' offices
Whoever visited Lisboa most recently starts; Influence discs in turn order on 4, 5, 6, 7
Public Buildings: shuffle blue side up, split into two stacks of 8, flip one to green; top tile of each onto its architect's plan space
Plan tiles in two faceup stacks by architect, fewest officials on top
4 Price markers on their market track spaces; a City tile on each City Building space
4 Scoring tiles shuffled, one per space below the downtown map
2 players: cover row E with the 2-player overlay
6 Clergy tiles faceup on the dark Church track spaces; Cardinal on the Influence space
Remaining Royal Favor tiles stacked on their portraits; Treasury marker on 3; goods and money as supply
Deal 5 blue (1755-1757) Political cards each; box the rest
Red deck (1758-1762) facedown on the Event display by type, top card of each of the 4 decks faceup
Ship cards: {n} of each; blue Ships stacked on red Ships in the shipyard
Shuffle the Decree deck; 8 faceup
steps.note: 2 players: replace Decrees showing the 2-player symbol

steps.text: Rubble: 1 random cube at the bottom of each column and the end of each row, 2 on each Public Building Site, 6 in the Rubble pile
steps.note: 2 players: skip row E and box the remaining cubes

steps.text: Play goes clockwise from the starting player
